Title: Runtime Code Review That Runs Your App on Every PR | Ito
# Catch all runtime bugs before merge. Ito is the only AI code review tool that builds your app on every PR, runs the impacted flows, and attaches the failing test to anything that breaks. SOC 2 Type II compliant. Thorough runtime evidence on every pull request: video, logs, reproduction steps, re-run on fix, prompt to fix. Automate the time each developer spends manually verifying AI code for runtime issues, with evidence. * When a PR opens, Ito reads the diff and the PR description, then focuses its **testing on the user flows your change affects**. * It builds the plan on its own, **no test cases to write and no suite to maintain**. * Add plain-English test instructions to prioritize the scenarios that matter and skip the ones that don't. * For every PR, **Ito builds and runs a real, single-use copy of your app from source**. * Ito navigates your app like a real user, and every action runs your real backend code, surfacing the logic and data bugs code review can't catch by reading the diff. * Beyond the happy path, it runs the edge cases and adversarial scenarios that real-world use exposes. * **Every failure includes everything you need to fix it fast**: a video replay, the exact lines responsible, and steps to reproduce. * Push a fix and Ito automatically re-runs to confirm it's resolved. We need verification that changes behave as expected, and that there are no loopholes for agents to exploit. Every other tool reads the code and reasons about the diff. * On every PR, Ito builds your app from source and exercises the entire flows your changes touch. * Any issues come with evidence: video, logs, and reproduction steps on the exact lines of code. Ito is the only code review tool that runs execution-based behavioral tests on every pull request to provide scriptless end-to-end validation and automated QA reports. Each pull request includes a full testing report with video, screenshots, and failure details delivered directly in the PR for faster review and triage. Each PR includes a full runtime report with video, screenshots, and failure details directly in the PR.
